name: DeepVoxels
definition: A learned representation that encodes the view-dependent appearance of a 3D scene without explicitly modeling its geometry, using a Cartesian 3D grid of persistent embedded features.
summary: DeepVoxels is a learned 3D scene representation using a persistent voxel grid to synthesize novel views by reasoning directly in 3D space, enabling explicit occlusion handling without requiring 3D ground truth.
